_comment: Copy this file to sources.json (same directory) and edit it. sources.json is gitignored,
because it names YOUR machine's directories.
RELATIVE paths resolve against THIS FILE's directory, not the process working directory --
an MCP server is launched from wherever the client feels like, so cwd is not dependable.
That is why the shipped example works from a fresh clone with no edits: it points at the
ABSOLUTE paths and ~ are both fine. Add one entry per memory dir you want searchable.
'name' is what you pass as project= to scope a search; keep it short and typeable.
Your real project vaults live at:
Ask Claude Code 'what is the absolute path to my memory directory?' inside that project, or
see docs/GETTING-STARTED.md. Your portable playbooks are worth indexing too -- give them the
name '_shared' so the craft-question search scope in ../conventions.md works as written.
_persist_dir_note: persist_dir is the vector INDEX, and it is DERIVED FROM THIS CONFIG'S SOURCES. Two configs
must never share one -- whichever server boots last reconciles the index down to its own
sources and silently evicts the other's memories.
So the default here is LOCAL to this clone (gitignored), which is the safe choice while you
are trying the pack out alongside an existing install. Once this IS your install, moving it
to ~/.claude/sabai-memory/index keeps the repo clean -- just don't point two configs there.
cache_dir is only the downloaded embedding MODEL (~90 MB). It is safe to share across
clones and machines-wide installs, so it stays under ~/.claude and you download it once.
